planning.assumed: M-NUM-02 cardinality and its counting ancestry. Small numeral reading/writing supported by adult if needed; names/species, spoken confirmation and a marking procedure are not required.

planning.scope: Two positive disjoint parts with total at most10. Optional equal-part cases, supplied sentence slots and three-part extension. No broad arithmetic fluency or unaided free expression construction claim.
planning.evidenceLimits: Assisted low-stakes response in supplied context. Model and marks visible; no persistent personal evidence, formal mastery, independence or retention inference.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Canonical direct-curriculum grades1–2 atomic node and exact M-NUM-02 AND group preserved. NCETM is foreign conceptual corroboration, not new OPH authority. Example counts, movement path, numbering and scaffolds are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG and renderer; supplied unchanged Loikka happy/Aava curious transparent PNGs. No mascot redraw or invented pose. Public release/licensing holds retained.

extensions.playback: 1.2 pieces per playback second is illustrative pacing, not physical duration measurement.
extensions.data: No personal or learner history. Optional marks indicate only local support.
